docs.subject: Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of IP CCTV system – 124 cameras, 30 days recording

items.name: Dahua 4MP IR Vandal-proof Dome IP Camera
items.desc: Model DH-IPC-HDBW2441E-S · WizSense, 2.8 mm, IR 30 m, H.265+, IK10, IP67, PoE · indoor areas

items.name: Dahua 4MP IR Bullet IP Camera
items.desc: Model DH-IPC-HFW2441S-S · WizSense, 2.8 mm, IR 30 m, H.265+, IP67, PoE · outdoor / perimeter

items.name: Camera Back Box / Junction Box
items.desc: Dahua aluminium junction box (IP66) matched to each camera model, for neat cable entry and mounting

items.name: Dahua 32-Channel AI NVR
items.desc: Model NVR5432-EI · 32 ch, 4 SATA bays, 4K HDMI output, WizSense AI search, H.265+ · 4 units = 128 channels (124 cameras + 4 spare)

items.name: Seagate SkyHawk 8TB Surveillance HDD
items.desc: 3.5" SATA, 24/7 rated · 3 per NVR = 24 TB per NVR for 30 days continuous recording (31 cameras × ~650 GB each, 4MP H.265 @ 2 Mbps)

items.name: Display 43" 4K UHD Monitor
items.desc: 43" 4K LED display for live view in security room, with wall bracket and 5 m HDMI cable

items.name: D-Link 24-port Gigabit PoE Smart Managed Switch
items.desc: Model DGS-1210-28P · 24 × GE PoE (193 W budget) + 4 SFP/combo, rack mount · 6 units = 144 PoE ports for 124 cameras

items.name: D-Link 24-port Gigabit Smart Managed Core Switch
items.desc: Model DGS-1210-28 · 24 × GE + 4 SFP · aggregates PoE switches and NVRs, terminates fibre uplink

items.name: 1G Single-mode SFP Module (LX, 10 km)
items.desc: D-Link DEM-310GT, LC duplex · one at each end of the fibre uplink

items.name: Fibre Optic Cable 6-core Single-mode Armoured
items.desc: OS2, outdoor/indoor armoured, for uplink from CCTV rack to main network room (estimated 200 m)

items.name: Fibre Patch Panel (LIU) 12-port, Rack-mount
items.desc: 1U sliding LIU with LC adapters, splice tray and SM pigtails · one at each end

items.name: LC-LC Single-mode Duplex Patch Cord 3 m
items.desc: OS2 fibre patch cords for SFP connection

items.name: Fibre Splicing & OTDR Testing
items.desc: Fusion splicing of 6 cores at both ends, OTDR / power-meter test report

items.name: 42U Floor-standing Network Rack 800 × 1000
items.desc: 800 W × 1000 D, perforated front & rear doors, side panels, 4 roof fans, 2 fixed shelves, castors & levelling feet, earthing kit

items.name: PDU 12-way Rack-mount
items.desc: 19" universal sockets with surge protection and switch

items.name: 1U Horizontal Cable Manager
items.desc: Metal, with D-rings, for neat patching

items.name: 24-port Cat6 Patch Panel (loaded)
items.desc: 1U, 19", with rear cable management · 6 panels = 144 ports

items.name: Cat6 Patch Cord 1 m
items.desc: Moulded boots · camera ports, switch uplinks and NVR connections

items.name: APC Smart-UPS 3 kVA Rack-mount
items.desc: Model SMT3000RMI2UC · 3000 VA / 2700 W, pure sine wave, LCD · backup for switches, NVRs and monitor (≈1.3 kW load)

items.name: Cat6 U/UTP LSZH Cable 305 m (Schneider Actassi)
items.desc: 23 AWG solid copper, LSZH · 124 points × avg 50 m + 5% wastage ≈ 6510 m

items.name: RJ45 Cat6 Connectors with Boots (100 pcs)
items.desc: Camera-end termination

items.name: GI Cable Tray / Trunking 100 × 50 mm with Cover
items.desc: Main cable route with couplers, bends, tees, hangers and supports (estimated 300 m)

items.name: PVC Heavy-gauge Conduit 20 mm with Fittings
items.desc: Drops from main route to each camera (avg 15 m per point) incl. saddles, bends, couplers and junction boxes

items.name: Flexible Conduit 20 mm with Glands
items.desc: Final connection into each camera back box (1.5 m per point)

items.name: Installation of Containment
items.desc: Fixing of cable tray/trunking and conduit system as per route plan, incl. fixings and supports

items.name: Cable Pulling, Termination & Testing
items.desc: Per point: pull Cat6 through containment, terminate RJ45 at camera and patch panel at rack, label both ends, continuity / Fluke test

items.name: Camera Installation & Alignment
items.desc: Per camera: mount back box and camera, focus and angle adjustment to agreed field of view

items.name: Fibre Cable Laying
items.desc: Pull and fix 6-core armoured fibre in containment between CCTV rack and network room

items.name: Rack Assembly, NVR & Network Configuration
items.desc: Rack build, UPS/PDU, switches (VLAN, PoE, uplink), NVR setup, HDD format, recording schedule, AI rules, user accounts, DMSS mobile & SmartPSS remote viewing

items.name: Testing, Commissioning & Handover
items.desc: End-to-end test, 30-day retention check, user training, camera schedule, as-built drawings and handover documents

items.name: Access Equipment & Consumables
items.desc: Ladders / mobile scaffold, cable ties, labels, sleeves, fixings and site consumables

docs.notes: Design basis: 84 dome + 40 bullet Dahua 4MP WizSense cameras; 4 × 32-ch NVR (31 cameras each); 30 days continuous recording at 4MP H.265, 20 fps (~2 Mbps per camera ≈ 650 GB per camera per month) on 3 × 8 TB per NVR; all cameras home-run on Cat6 to one 42U rack (max 90 m per run); one single-mode fibre uplink to the client network. Quantities of cable and containment are estimates and will be measured on site.
docs.terms:
Prices are valid for 15 days from the quotation date.
Payment: 50% advance with LPO, 40% on delivery of materials, 10% on testing & commissioning.
Delivery: 2–3 weeks for materials from LPO; installation 3–4 weeks depending on site access.
Warranty: 2 years on Dahua equipment (manufacturer), 1 year on workmanship.
Exclusions: civil works, core drilling, false-ceiling opening/closing, power points, fire-stopping, permits and internet connection.
Cable and containment lengths are estimates; final quantities will be measured and billed as installed.
